contract_modal.title: Secure Payment Contract
contract_modal.hero_title: How Your Secure Payment Contract Works
contract_modal.hero_description: Your funds are protected by a blockchain smart contract that automatically enforces fair rules for both parties.
contract_modal.money_protected_locked: Funds are locked in the smart contract. Only the contract's rules can release them; the owner cannot access them.
contract_modal.money_protected_no_intermediaries: No intermediaries. Direct peer-to-peer; only you and the other party can interact with your contract.
contract_modal.for_taskers_locked: Funds stay locked until you accept completed work.
contract_modal.for_taskers_review: 7-day review period after completion; if you don't respond, payment releases automatically.
contract_modal.for_taskers_grace: 1-hour grace period: cancel for a full refund within 1 hour of creating the payment contract.
contract_modal.for_taskers_dispute: Dispute rights: file a dispute within 7 days of completion; if unresolved after 14 days, you get a full refund.
contract_modal.for_taskers_cancel: Cancel any time for a full refund at any point prior to within 24 hours of start time
contract_modal.for_taskers_no_show: No-show protection: if the freelancer doesn't start on time, mark them as no-show; they have 24 hours to respond or you get a full refund.
contract_modal.for_taskees_guaranteed: Guaranteed payment: once you mark work complete, the client has 7 days to accept; if they don't respond, you're paid automatically after 7 days.
contract_modal.for_taskees_upfront: Upfront deposits: can request partial payment upfront (claimable after 1-hour grace period).
contract_modal.for_taskees_dispute: Dispute rights: can propose how to split payment during disputes (up to 2 proposals).
contract_modal.for_taskees_refund: Voluntary refund: can refund the Tasker at any time.
contract_modal.platform_fees_both: Both parties pay a fee to BitTasker.
contract_modal.platform_fees_deducted: Fees are deducted when money moves, not upfront.
contract_modal.platform_fees_apply: Fees apply to upfront deposits, final payments, dispute resolutions, and cancellation fees.
contract_modal.time_limits_grace: 1 hour grace period: cancel for free within 1 hour of creation.
contract_modal.time_limits_cancellation: 24-hour cancellation window: Taskers cannot cancel within 24 hours of the start time.
contract_modal.time_limits_review: 7-day completion review: Tasker has 7 days to accept or dispute after you mark complete.
contract_modal.time_limits_dispute_resolution: 14-day dispute resolution: if no agreement, Tasker gets a full refund.
contract_modal.time_limits_dispute_filing: 7-day dispute filing window: taskers can only dispute within 7 days of completion.
contract_modal.time_limits_no_show: 24-hour no-show response: taskees have 24 hours to respond to no-show claims.
contract_modal.dispute_process_step2: Either party can propose a split (e.g., 60% to Taskee, 40% refund to Tasker).
contract_modal.dispute_process_step3: The other party can accept; if accepted, funds distribute immediately.
contract_modal.dispute_process_step4: Proposals alternate; each party can make up to 2 proposals.
contract_modal.dispute_process_step5: If no agreement after 14 days, tasker gets a full refund.
contract_modal.cancellation_tasker_one_hour: Within 1 hour: full refund, no fees.
contract_modal.cancellation_tasker_after_hour: After 1 hour: cancellation fee may apply (if set).
contract_modal.cancellation_tasker_24_hours: Cannot cancel within 24 hours of start time.
contract_modal.cancellation_taskee_anytime: Can refund anytime; tasker gets a full refund with no cancellation fee.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_funds: Funds are locked and only released per contract rules.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_fees: Fees are transparent and deducted automatically.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_disputes: Disputes have a fair negotiation process with automatic fallback.
contract_modal.agreeing_to_no_reversals: No reversals: blockchain transactions are permanent once executed.
contract_modal.not_agreeing_to_access: Letting anyone access funds outside contract rules.
contract_modal.not_agreeing_to_standards: Accepting work that doesn't meet agreed standards.
contract_modal.not_agreeing_to_third_party: A third party determining the outcome of payments.
contract_modal.summary: The contract protects both parties with automatic enforcement, transparent fees, and multiple refund paths if things go wrong.
